description: Advance the workspace cursor by one toward the tail of the ops log, replaying the next op that was previously undone. Calling redo when the cursor is already at the tail (no undone ops to fast-forward) fails rather than silently no-op. Note: any new op applied via apply-op / mutate-map after an undo truncates the redo tail (standard edit-stack semantics).

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: redo
title: Redo a previously-undone op
